title: Comic Issue Read Backlog by Arc
dataSources: Discogs collection entries (`discogs:item`), comics (`comic:item`), coin catalogue entries (`coin:item`), stamp album entries (`stamp:item`), and watch logs (`watch:item`).
app: Collection telemetry from Discogs, Comic Vine, coin and stamp catalogues, and watch-collection trackers sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=comic:item
| stats count(eval(read_status!="read")) as unread_issues count as issues by story_arc
| sort 0 - unread_issues
description: Ranks story arcss by comic read backlog.
value: Backlog by arc helps you pick up a story where it actually makes narrative sense instead of chasing issue numbers blindly.
implementation: Send comic read backlog events to `index=personal` and keep `story_arc` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of comic read backlog by story arcs.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which story arcss stand out most for comic read backlog.
